full_judgment: 2. Plaintiff Nazma Hafiz instituted Title Suit No. 74/73 on 21-7-73 against defendant No. 1 Zarina Khatun, wife of Md. Waliullah, 3/1, Kailash Ghosh Lane, PS Kotwali, Dhaka and defendant No. 2 Government of Bangladesh represented by the Deputy Commissioner, Dhaka praying for a decree for specific performance of contract in respect of the suit property described in the schedule i.e. 06 acre of land being Municipal Holding No. 66 and CS plot No. 97 (part) of CS Khatian No. 157 in Mouza Baje Kakrail, PS Ramna, Dhaka. Defendant No. 1 Zarina Khatun, according to the plaintiff, entered into a written agreement dated 7-1-71 to sell the suit property to the plaintiff for Taka 55,000.00 after accepting advance consideration money of Taka 45,000.00 and gave delivery of possession of the suit property to the plaintiff on the same date. Plaintiff rented out the property to Mrs. Safia Ali, wife of Mr. SM Ali who stayed there till January, 1973 and thereafter the said tenant vacated the suit property and since then the plaintiff has been residing in the said property. It was stipulated in the agreement dated 7-1-71 that the defendant No. 1 shall execute and register the deed of sale in favour of plaintiff on receipt of the balance consideration money of Rs. 10,000.00 before 31st December, 1971 after getting necessary income tax clearance certificate and gain tax, etc. Thereafter plaintiff offered the balance consideration money of Rs. 10,000.00 from 1971 to 9th July, 1973 and asked defendant No.1 to execute and register the sale deed but defendant No. 1 ultimately refused to execute and register the deed in favour of the plaintiff on 9th July, 1973. The plaintiff therefore, was compelled to institute this title suit. By amendment of the plaint the plaintiff added in the plaint that the plaintiff has acquired an equitable title in the suit property by virtue of the written agreement dated 7-1-71 executed by defendant no.1 in favour of the plaintiff, that the letter dated 4-3-73 issued by defendant No. 4, Deputy Secretary, Ministry of Public Works and Urban Development, Government of Bangladesh is illegal and that the Government of Bangladesh had no right to dispossess the plaintiff from the suit property. The plaintiff also added Secretary, Ministry of Public Works and Deputy Secretary, Ministry of Public Works as defendant Nos. 3 and 4.
